text:
anna-dev: Heads up — since the sanitizer change we pushed yesterday, we’re seeing a small spike in invoke rejects from structured outputs. Sanitizer currently drops unknown keys before schema validate; a few tool responses become empty objects and get rejected. Anyone seen this pattern? 

mike-p: do we have a repro or example payload? route/variant? 

anna-dev: repro attached inline. Example tool response we got in logs: 
```
{"tool_name":"wiki_fetch","response":{},"metadata":{"source":"ext-api","confidence":0.7}}
```
After sanitizer drop -> `{}` -> schema reject (required `items` missing). 

ops-bot: deploy: sanitizer-v2 rolled to prod at 1722190000 by @anna-dev :rocket:

julia-ml: hm. Two quick thoughts: 1) instead of dropping unknown keys, annotate them (e.g., `_sanitized_extra`) so object not empty; 2) add a fallback route/circuit-breaker that routes these reject-y responses to the degen variant (cheaper, lower-quality) and surface a clear telemetry tag. 

mike-p: agree on telemetry — we need an event that ties sanitizer behavior + routing decision + quota attribution. e.g.: 
```
{
  "event":"invoke.result",
  "route":"/v1/generate",
  "sanitizer.mode":"drop",
  "sanitizer.outcome":"empty_after_drop",
  "fallback_route":"degen-low",
  "billing_tag":"fallback:degen-low",
  "sample":true
}
```
This lets billing and console filter by `sanitizer.outcome`. 

julia-ml: also recommend rollout plan: enable `annotate` mode for 5% canary (both host & dedicated), collect `sanitizer.outcome` + `schema.reject_reason`, then only flip default if annotated payloads reduce rejects and downstream metrics look ok. 

billing-bot: note: current billing logic attributes token usage to the final route. If we route to degen-low, customers get billed at degen rates. Ops: do we want a flag to mark internal fallbacks as non-billable (or billed to Redwood) for a short period while we iterate? 

mike-p: that's the debate — if we absorb cost we can iterate faster, but product may object. For now add `billing_tag` above so we can backfill charges and decide. Also add a console op to toggle `sanitizer.mode` per-customer. 

anna-dev: I can prototype the `annotate` change + telemetry in a small PR. Will also add a dashboard tile: "sanitizer_empty_rate" (per-route), and alert if >0.25% sustained 1h. 

julia-ml: please also add a sampled stacktrace when `sanitizer.outcome==empty_after_drop` so we can see which tool adapters are generating these empties. 

mike-p: UX ask for console: new column in route table showing `sanitizer.mode` + a quick-link to sampled events. Also add a rollout toggle to force `annotate` for a single customer for debugging. 

anna-dev: ack. I'll open a PR with changes: sanitizer annotate + telemetry + dashboard tile. tag owners: @mike-p for console, @julia-ml for sampling, @billing-bot for billing tag review. :eyes: 

mike-p: thanks — please include example queries for the logs team (ES/KQL) to find these events. 

anna-dev: will do, tnx all.
